messages:
maria.design: quick flag — putting sampling right next to the timepicker is confusing users. suggestion: separate the concerns visually. time controls scope, sampling controls performance.

sam.eng: agreed. backend already accepts a `sample` param so frontend can treat them independently. we'll expose sample=auto|0.1|0.25|0.5|1.

raj.product: tradeoffs: users expect exact p95 often. if default sampling hides regressions that's bad. what should auto do?

lina.pm: recommend `auto` map based on range: <15m -> 100%, 15m-6h -> 50%, 6h-24h -> 25%, >24h -> 10%. include inline copy explaining it's an estimate.

dylan.ux: UI idea: a small chip next to the timepicker that reads "Sampling: Auto". clicking opens a popover with quick picks (Auto / 10% / 25% / 50% / 100%) and a single-sentence explainer. add a subtle "estimated" pill next to p95 when sample != 1.

eva.a11y: a11y checklist: popover must trap focus, keyboard-only users can open and change values, aria-live region announces that the chart updated and whether p95 is estimated. contrast on the chosen option needs to meet WCAG.

ops-bot: deploy-note: new API param will be accepted by observability v2 endpoint.

sam.eng: implementation notes: API route: GET /api/observability/latency?range=1h&sample=auto. auto resolved server-side using heuristics. special-case: orgs on Dedicated default auto->1 to honor SLAs.

maria.design: microcopy drafts: short: "Sampling reduces points to speed up the dashboard; p95 may be estimated." tooltip action: "Run full query" which forces sample=1.

raj.product: add a safety guard: if sample<1 and sampled p95 differs >15% from most recent full-run baseline, show a yellow banner: "Sampled p95 differs from full-run by X% — view full results" with CTA. track telemetry for these events.

dylan.ux: visual changes: move percentile legend higher, show p50/p95 first, then show sampling state. keep heatmap opacity and density controls from duplicating — consolidate into a single control. provide an "Advanced" toggle to reveal the opacity slider.

eva.a11y: ensure the "estimated" badge has an aria-describedby that reads the same tooltip text for screen readers. keyboard users need a shortcut to toggle sampling (e.g., focusable chip).

lina.pm: product acceptance: mock with compact and advanced variants; microcopy finalized; server heuristics documented; telemetry events listed; guardrail threshold configurable.

sam.eng: plan: wire API, include header X-Sampled: true when sample<1 for easier infra debugging, record metrics on sample rates per org.

maria.design: action items: dylan -> mocks (compact + advanced) by Tue EOD; sam -> API + header + heuristics; eva -> a11y checklist + quick test; lina -> finalize copy & acceptance; raj -> telemetry & guardrail config. i'll assemble the handoff doc after mocks.

dylan.ux: will include keyboard walkthrough in mock.

eva.a11y: ping me on the PR for a quick screen-reader pass.

maria.design: thanks all — keeping this thread for follow-ups.
